title: Latency gate passes with target misses
evidence: Owner-authorized p90 policy explicitly allows up to 10 target misses; manifest policy latency-distribution-v2 and printed p90/p95/p99/max bounds distinguish acceptance. This reverses a settled decision without a defect.

title: Validate omits latency and catalog gates
evidence: make validate runs test across all packages, including TestEmbeddedSchemaCatalog. U6 explicitly requires separate check-generated and bench-cli; the plan never treats validate alone as sign-off.

title: Invalid-config matrix skips query paths
evidence: Reference contract limits bad-config latency cases to help/version. Query bad-config exits are already process/unit behavior tests; no requirement for bad-config query latency acceptance.

title: Benchmark scrubs parent heap each sample
evidence: Manifest pipe_consumer already records parent GC, preallocation, unchanged child GC, and launch-through-exit/drain. Other consumer conditions are separate retained diagnostics.

title: Catalog fast path skips live compile
evidence: TestEmbeddedSchemaCatalog always compiles every prefix via pinned SQLite under make test, race, coverage and short tests. Claim that validate skips this test is false.
